title: Dividing Powers of Ten
text: When dividing numbers in scientific notation, divide the coefficients and subtract the exponents. For 10^a / 10^b = 10^(a-b).

title: Performing the Division
text: I/I_0 = (1.0 x 10^-5)/(1.0 x 10^-12) = (1.0/1.0) x 10^(-5-(-12)) = 1.0 x 10^(-5+12) = 10^7. This means the sound is 10 million times more intense than the threshold of hearing.
